title: Removable orthodontic plate for a child
what: The plate is a removable plastic device with small wires. It slowly moves the teeth and helps the jaw grow correctly.
why: For children with a wrong bite, crowded teeth or a narrow jaw, while the bones are still growing.
duration: taking impressions usually takes 15 to 20 minutes; the plate is usually worn from several months to 1 to 2 years
tell_doctor: Your child's allergies, including to plastic and metals
Habits: thumb sucking, pacifier, mouth breathing
How ready your child is to look after the plate

prepare.title: Mood
prepare.text: Explain to your child why the plate is needed. Your child will have to wear it every day.

prepare.title: Teeth
prepare.text: Brush your child's teeth before the visit.

bring: The case, if you already have one
steps: The doctor takes impressions or scans the teeth
The plate is made from the impression
At the next visit it is tried on and adjusted
The doctor shows your child and you how to put it in and take it out
You are told how often to turn the screw and when to come for checks
feel: In the first days it presses and makes talking hard
Extra saliva in the first days. It passes
Teeth may ache after the screw is turned
after: Wear it for as many hours a day as the doctor said
Take it out to eat if the doctor said so
Keep it in its case. Do not wrap it in a napkin
Come to check-ups at the set time
red_flags: The plate has rubbed the gum into a sore
The plate broke or no longer fits: see the doctor

faq.q: What if my child does not want to wear it?
faq.a: The plate does not work if it is not worn. Talk to the doctor, who can explain to your child and suggest how to help.

faq.q: Can my child eat with it in?
faq.a: Usually the plate is taken out for meals. Check with the doctor.

reminders.text: Orthodontist visit tomorrow. Brush your child's teeth and bring the case if you already have one.
